summary: Keep read-only live verification from mistaking synthetic IDs for account resources, and make dry-run JSON deterministic across local and workflow commands.
reason: The first authenticated publish gate exposed fixture-only 404s and several commands that accepted --dry-run while emitting normal output. Agents need resource-aware verification and one consistent dry_run envelope without account mutations.
validated_outcome: Targeted regression tests require valid JSON dry-run envelopes, prohibit hard-coded live IDs for resource lookups, and require an executable webhook-gap example. Full authenticated gate must be rerun.
